meta.title: Serenova — tailored safaris in East Africa
meta.description: A travel house in Lausanne. Jenny designs personal safaris in Tanzania, Zanzibar and Kilimanjaro — at your pace, never from a catalogue.

home.introBody: Extraordinary places. Meaningful journeys. We design personal safaris that bring you closer to the land, to unforgettable wildlife, and to moments that stay.
home.momentCaption: Your journey. Your rhythm. Your Africa.
home.tanzaniaBody: Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire, the migration. This is Serenova’s craft — composed day by day, never held in stock.
home.zanzibarBody: Pale sand, turquoise water, Stone Town. Often the exhale after safari — sometimes the journey itself.
home.stylesBody: Family, honeymoon, photography, walking, migration, fly-in, halal, or simply the beach. We start with you, not a catalogue.
home.journeysBody: Jenny reads every request herself. Prices shown are “from” figures, for two travellers.
home.aboutBody: Serenova began with a first journey to Tanzania that never quite ended. Jenny designs every itinerary by hand, with trusted local partners, and reviews every enquiry herself.
home.ctaTitle: Tell us the journey you are imagining
home.ctaBody: Four questions are enough. Jenny replies in person — WhatsApp, a call, or email.
